issues: The acceptance test runner crashes with UnicodeEncodeError before any tests can run, causing test_acceptance.py to exit with code 1. This prevents verification of UI flows and other acceptance criteria. The script needs to handle Unicode characters correctly when printing the Jest command (e.g., replace the emoji with an ASCII fallback or encode output safely).

The UI accessibility check fails due to nested interactive elements: buttons with data-testid="fab-container" are nested inside other pressable elements (FABAdd component). This violates the accessibility rule and prevents the primary flow test from clicking the "Add" button. Refactor the FAB and related components to remove nested buttons, ensuring only a single interactive element per hierarchy.

The primary flow test times out when trying to click the "Add" button on both phone and desktop, likely caused by the nested-interactive issue above. Ensure the "Add" button is reachable and correctly labeled for the UI flow.

The task requires new functionality such as deleting the encryption key on data reset, backup passphrase rules (minimum 12 characters), temporary backup file cleanup after sharing, receipt photo handling with new File API, numeric validation with helper text, backup format validation before restoring, disabling export buttons during export, and adding unit tests for these behaviours. The repository currently lacks implementations for many of these changes (e.g., src/lib/validation.ts, src/lib/files.ts, updated backup logic, updated UI screens, added unit tests). Implement the missing code and ensure all new unit tests (dataReset.test.ts, passphraseRules.test.ts, validation.test.ts, restoreValidation.test.ts) are present and passing.

Ensure that the numeric validation functions (validateReceiptAmount, validateMileageMiles, validateMileageRate, validateTaxRate, validateBackupPassphrase) return the expected error messages and that screens display HelperText errors and disable Save/Create buttons accordingly. Currently these functions are either missing or not integrated.
feedback: Fix the acceptance test runner Unicode issue, resolve nested-interactive accessibility violations (especially in FABAdd), implement all hardening requirements and corresponding unit tests, and verify that the UI flow can click the "Add" button without timeouts. Once these issues are addressed, ensure all tests pass and static validation succeeds.
